title.narrative: Provision of Operational Support Services to Arms Embargo Cell in Democratic Republic of the Congo (MONUSCO)

description.narrative: In January 2015, the United Nations Organization Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (MONUSCO) Arms Embargo Working Group was created. Its purpose was to coordinate and improve the Mission's work on watching over how the arms ban is enforced in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Working Group included the Joint Mission Analysis Center, which was the leader, the United Nations Police with the Serious and Organized Crime Support Unit, the Force, the Disarmament Demobilization, Repatriation, Resettlement and Reintegration Section, and the United Nations Mine Action Service. In October 2015, the United Nations Organization Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo created the Arms Embargo Cell to further support the Arms Embargo Working Group.\n\nUNOPS offers operationa support to MONUSCO.
